case.question: Is there anywhere to play badmington near Coburg?
case.note: Misspelt sport. Either confirm it via list_sports or search the corrected name; 8 badminton venues exist near Coburg.

result.answer:
Yes. Eight venues near the centre of Coburg are listed for badminton. The three closest are Essendon Christ Church Badminton Club (4624 m), Carlton Baths Community Centre (5329 m) and Doutta Galla Ladies Badminton Club at the Doutta Galla Youth Hall, North Essendon (5453 m). Five more are further out, including Darebin Community Sports Stadium, Reservoir (6405 m). Distances are straight-line metres.

On access: Carlton Baths has an accessible toilet and accessible parking at the venue, per the Sport and Recreational Facilities List, last updated 2024-12-17. For Essendon Christ Church, a public accessible toilet is 258 m away (National Public Toilet Map, last updated 2022-01-12). No published information on a step-free station for any of them, check with the venue.
